text:
```yaml
name: Docker Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  packages: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  docker-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker
        uses: docker/setup-docker-action@v4
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/xiangpenghao/liquid-cache:${{ github.ref_name }}
            ghcr.io/xiangpenghao/liquid-cache:latest
          build-args: |
            VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}
```
